validation.method: Download to process memory; SHA-256; validateMergedImage(bytes, chipBoard, flashMiB * 1024 * 1024). Expected complete image origin is 0; ESP32 boot header at 0x1000, ESP32-S3 header at 0, partition table at 0x8000.

redactedFields: download counts not used for conclusions
privacy.effect: Source hashes are hashes of the actually fetched upstream body; only source receipts, board names, version identities and artifact metadata are committed. No firmware bytes, user information or private originals are retained.
